text:
alex: quick heads-up
I noticed the streaming example in streaming.md uses resume_token in Python but the TS and Go snippets in pagination.md are single-shot. users will copy the wrong pattern.

chi: thanks, can you paste the snippets?

alex: python (short):
```python
resp = client.responses.create(model="rwd-4x", input=prompt, stream=True, resume_token=last_token)
for evt in resp:
    if evt.type == 'delta':
        sys.stdout.write(evt.delta)
```

rafa: we should make TS show async iterator + resumeToken and update Go to show cursor pagination + Retry-After handling.

nika: i'll take TS. propose async iterator example like:
```ts
const s = await client.responses.stream({ model: 'rwd-4x', input: prompt, resumeToken: lastToken });
for await (const ev of s) {
  if (ev.type === 'delta') process.stdout.write(ev.delta ?? '');
}
```

rafa: i'll do Go. will add a loop with cursor and a minimal exponential backoff honoring Retry-After header.

docs-bot: checklist: 1) Update TS streaming sample, 2) Update Go pagination snippet with retry, 3) Add one-line resume note across pages, 4) Add a mocked smoke test under /examples/smoke/ to run in docs CI.

alex: timeline: nika and rafa aiming to open PRs in the next 3 hours so we can land before the morning docs cut. i'll add a cross-ref between streaming.md and pagination.md.

chi: sounds good. please ensure param names are idiomatic per language (`resume_token` vs `resumeToken` vs `ResumeToken`) and add a single sentence about idempotency/resume semantics.

nika: opened PR -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4511 (TS + smoke harness). CI mocked smoke passed.

rafa: opened PR -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4512 (Go cursor + retry). added Retry-After handling.

alex: opened cross-ref PR -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4513. left a tiny wording nit that chi fixed.

chi: all merged. release note draft: "Unify streaming and pagination examples across SDKs; add resume/retry guidance and smoke tests."

docs-bot: Release reminder scheduled for 08:00 UTC tomorrow.

alex: closing thread. ping here if anything regresses.
